overview: Trevone is a sandy, family-friendly beach in a small bay near Padstow, with a village shop, surf shop and seasonal café nearby, lifeguards in season and parking next to the sand. Water quality has been rated very highly.

The bay is a protected site for its geology, with fossils in the rocks of the headlands. Don’t miss the Round Hole, a big sinkhole formed where a sea cave collapsed, in a field up on the eastern side.

expect.title: The beach
expect.text: A sandy bay with rocky headlands on either side.

expect.title: The Round Hole
expect.text: A large sinkhole above the bay where a sea cave has collapsed; impressive to see, but keep well back from the edge.

expect.title: Fossils
expect.text: The headlands contain fossils and are protected for their geology.

goodToKnow.label: Dogs
goodToKnow.text: No dogs are allowed on the beach in the summer months.

goodToKnow.label: Village
goodToKnow.text: A village hall, shop, surf shop and a small seasonal café.

week.text: A lovely family beach near Padstow. Walk the coast path west to Harlyn or east towards Padstow for big views.

pairWith.why: a surf beach a short walk west
the harbour town for food and boat trips
a small marine centre in Padstow

tips: Walk up to the Round Hole: children love peering into it.
